response.original_title: 時空警察ヴェッカー　シブヤネクサス
response.overview: Latest installment of the "Jikuu Keisatsu Wecker" franchise, celebrating its 25th anniversary. Nagi Sakuma, a Space-Time Police cadet who has traveled from the future to the present day, meets Hana Mashiro, a university student who loves nature. Believing that protecting history is an absolute mission—and having rarely experienced any emotional fluctuations—Nagi discovers what it means to cherish someone after meeting Hana. However, when it is revealed that Hana is fated to lose her life, Nagi finds himself torn between protecting the person he loves and upholding history.
response.title: Jikuu Keisatsu Wecker - Shibuya Nexus
